title: Mom Calls Police On Her 23-Year-Old Abusive Son, Then He Runs Away
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On June 3rd, 2023, an officer was called to a residence regarding a dispute between a mom and her son. The son was yelling and swearing at his mom causing mom to call the police. This is footage of the events that followed.
